_about: Generated independently (Python hashlib SHA3-256 + hmac) from docs/KEY-SCHEDULE.md. Byte-pattern inputs are NOT valid keys, only hashed. Rust: tests/kdf_kat.rs.

rules.entry: h_seq = H(D[audit/v1/entry], [h_prev, line_bytes]); line_bytes is the line as written, without its newline
rules.checkpoint: the gateway signs H(D[audit/v1/checkpoint], [log_id, be64(through_seq), h_through_seq]) with SLH-DSA-Shake128f
rules.tail: a segment_start records H(D[audit/v1/tail], [last line of the file before it]) as prev_tail
